eval.title: SPGI Stock Represents A Wonderful Business...

call.headline_quote: we'll keep looking for the same businesses but as Buffett did at P ratios of 10

base_metric.name: eps
base_metric.quote: earnings per share of 15 14 if you look at not Gap metric 17 earnings per share growing huge operating profits

what_is_priced_in.quote: except the tiny detail of the price earnings ratio 43

reasons.claim: A P/E of 43 is too expensive relative to what Buffett paid for the same type of business.
reasons.quote: p ratio of 10 and you are now paying 40 for something Warren Buffett paid 104 that's the key disc discrepancy there

data_check.gap_note: he says 43, as-of 61.3143 (FY2023); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Rating agencies have a durable moat because they let money managers shift blame for bad investment outcomes onto the rating.
reasons.quote: it's not my fault is the key selling point of the business it will be there forever when it comes to the investment environment

reasons.claim: Even in the 2022 downturn and the 2008-2011 crisis, revenue fell but the business stayed profitable, showing resilience.
reasons.quote: in a declining Market revenues decreased 4% but the company given the quality given the great business still had profitability still made made money

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.04, as-of 0.1177 (FY2023); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Buybacks and 52 consecutive years of dividend increases signal a great business.
reasons.quote: they raised the annual dividend for 52 consecutive years that's even one more than Archer Daniel Midlands

data_check.gap_note: he says 52, as-of 3.6517 (FY2023); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: If the market crashes and revenues drop sharply, high current valuation would fall further even though the business stays profitable.
reasons.quote: if revenues decline 40% on the market crash likely profitability will still decline however it would still remain I think profitable

external_facts_used: Warren Buffett's 2010 Berkshire annual conference comments on rating agencies
Buffett/Berkshire owning more than 50% of Moody's
Buffett's original 1999-era purchase price and stake (~$500 million for 15%)
AI conference call commentary on generative AI as benefit vs threat
ChatGPT-generated bullish/bearish analysis of the stock

critic.notes: ok. Reason 5 category 'macro_rates' is loose (it's a valuation/crash-risk point) but the claim is supported. Wonderful business, but he passes at P/E 43, closing that he'll keep looking for such businesses at Buffett's P/E 10.
